// diagnostic

E0221

A write into a shared value can close a strong `Shared` reference cycle.

What

A write into a shared value can close a strong `Shared` reference cycle.

Why

Strong `Shared` handles keep each other alive; a cycle through them never frees.

Fix

Store a `Shared.Weak<T>` back-edge or an id, or build the stored value from new cells.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0221: tests/ui/shared_strong_cycle.stderr.

Error [jet.SharedReferenceCycle]: This write can close a strong `Shared` cycle through `Node`
  --> tests/ui/shared_strong_cycle.jet:10:5
    |
 10 |     b.next = Val(a)
    |     ^^^^^^
 Why: The stored value may already reach this `Node` cell through strong `Shared` handles, and reference counting never frees a strong cycle
 Fix: Store a `Shared.Weak<Node>` back-edge (`.downgrade()`) or an id, or build the stored value here from new cells (`shared Node{…}`)
